properties.sfomuseum:description: Typewritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to S. [Stokley] W. Morgan, dated September 23, 1933, in Shanghai; letter recommending “Howard” [Major Edward Howard?] for the position of division manager for Pan American Airways’ Far Eastern division; includes Mr. Bixby’s thoughts about his ongoing employment with Pan American, including bringing his family to China.
